title.zh: Solana moves Alpenglow into testnet as SOL nears January highs
title.en: Solana moves Alpenglow into testnet as SOL nears January highs

current_state.zh: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
current_state.en: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
